title: ISC2 CCSP: Certified Cloud Security Professional
subtitle: Trening za CCSP po ISC2 outlineu od 1. 8. 2026: 6 domena (arhitektura, podaci, platforma, aplikacije, operacije, pravo i rizik), uključujući nove teme o AI/ML, sa pitanjima u ISC2 stilu i CAT simulacijom.

exam.note: Pravi CCSP je CAT (adaptivni) ispit: 100–150 pitanja (oko 25 se ne boduje), 3 sata, prolaz 700/1000, kod Pearson VUE. Uslov za titulu je 5 godina IT iskustva (3 u sigurnosti, 1 u CCSP domenama); bez toga postaješ Associate of ISC2. Ova simulacija ima fiksnih 125 pitanja.
exam.note_en: The real CCSP is a CAT (adaptive) exam: 100–150 questions (about 25 are unscored), 3 hours, passing score 700/1000, delivered at Pearson VUE. Earning the credential requires 5 years of IT experience (3 in security, 1 in the CCSP domains); without it you become an Associate of ISC2. This simulation has a fixed 125 questions.

objectives.en: Understand cloud computing concepts
Describe cloud reference architecture
Understand security concepts relevant to cloud computing
Understand design principles of secure cloud computing
Evaluate Cloud Service Providers (CSP)
Comprehend Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML)
Describe cloud data concepts
Design and implement cloud data storage architectures
Design and apply data security technologies and strategies
Implement data discovery
Plan and implement data classification
Design and implement Information Rights Management (IRM)
Plan and implement data retention, deletion and archiving policies
Design and implement auditability, traceability and accountability of data events
objectives.bs: Auditabilnost, sljedivost i odgovornost za događaje nad podacima

objectives.en: Comprehend data protection of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) data
Comprehend cloud infrastructure components
Design a secure data center
Analyze risks associated with cloud infrastructure and platforms
Plan and implementation of security controls
Plan Business Continuity (BC) and Disaster Recovery (DR)
objectives.bs: Kontinuitet poslovanja i oporavak od katastrofe (BC/DR)

objectives.en: Advocate training and awareness for application security
objectives.bs: Obuka i svijest o sigurnosti aplikacija

objectives.en: Describe the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) process
Apply the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Apply cloud software assurance and validation
Use verified secure software
Comprehend and apply the specifics of cloud application architecture
Design appropriate Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
Build and implement physical and logical infrastructure for cloud environment
Operate and maintain physical and logical infrastructure for cloud environment
objectives.bs: Rad i održavanje fizičke i logičke infrastrukture

objectives.en: Implement operational controls and standards (e.g., National Institute Of Standards And Technology (NIST), International Organization For Standardization (ISO), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPPA), Control Objectives For Information And Related Technology (COBIT), Center For Internet Security (CIS) Controls, Comittee Of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO), Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) International Organization For Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission (ISO/IEC) 20000-1)
objectives.bs: Operativne kontrole i standardi (NIST, ISO, COBIT, CIS, ITIL…)

objectives.en: Support digital forensics
Manage communication with relevant parties
Manage security operations
Articulate legal requirements and unique risks within the cloud environment
objectives.bs: Pravni zahtjevi i specifični rizici clouda

objectives.en: Understand privacy requirements
Understand audit processes, methodologies, and required adaptations for a cloud environment
Understand implications of cloud to enterprise risk management
objectives.bs: Uticaj clouda na upravljanje rizikom preduzeća

objectives.en: Understand outsourcing and cloud contract design

title_en: ISC2 CCSP: Certified Cloud Security Professional
subtitle_en: Training for the CCSP based on the ISC2 exam outline effective August 1, 2026: 6 domains (architecture, data, platform, applications, operations, legal and risk), including the new AI/ML topics, with ISC2-style questions and a CAT simulation.
